changes: Tasker's screens are rebuilt from smaller source files; nothing you see or do changes
A photo added when submitting a task or raising an issue is attached to it, so anyone who can open the task or issue can open the photo
An acknowledged issue can be given a new owner, who acknowledges it afresh
Issues with severity, SLA clocks in store hours or round the clock, and escalation at 75% and at breach
Waiting for a vendor pauses an issue only with the store manager's approval; issues close through verification
A task can have a verifier; it is submitted with a note and closed only when the verifier accepts it
Assignees acknowledge new work; due date moves and cancellations need a reason
Tasks can have a start date and a due date, and show Overdue, Due today or Scheduled
Tasks can belong to a store or warehouse; the Stores page counts each store's work
Takes the platform's latest shared interface updates; Tasker itself is unchanged (#1044)
Admin → Apps shows what changed in each Tasker version (#938)
Activity history names people and projects instead of record ids (#563)
Your own questions and messages never show as unread to you (#563)
Tasker returns as a product app: only members can open it (#563)
Quick capture goes to a private Inbox; shared projects are for the team (#563)
My Work puts conversations that need you first, then your Focus (#563)
Assignable subtasks, questions with replies, and recurring tasks (#563)
